title: Period 11 · Week 1
closer: Two blackout weeks ahead. The Kompass notes will be waiting, as they always are.

stops.title: Welcome
stops.narration: Alright, everyone. This is the briefing for Period eleven, week one, District eight. Thirty-eight hours across nineteen sets, and twelve of those hours belong to one Asian Foods set that has opinions. After this week come two blackout weeks, so let's finish strong. Checkpoints along the way, and they count.

stops.title: The Week at a Glance
stops.narration: Here is the week on one screen. Grocery carries six sets, Health Beauty Care carries four, the produce department carries two, meat carries three, and Natural Foods carries four. Traditional Asian is the big one at twelve hours, then Baked Bread at six. Eight sets run cold, and every cold set has a twenty-minute limit on product out of the case.

stops.title: Traditional Asian
stops.narration: Traditional Asian is the heavy lift, twelve hours, and the test store confirms it. Here is your action item for this week. The item lookup drops the last digit of the U-P-C, so valid items can look like they are not on the set. The test store found about half a dozen. Verify before you set anything aside. The core runs about twice the Kroger size. The first two or three bays are heavy glass bottles with private label expanding, and most of that product shifts side to side, so move it carefully. Tofu moves to the top, and curry soup mixes come down into the snack area. Snacks and drinks are mostly vertical, with some drinks shifting left. The noodle section has the biggest change and the most new items, and it is the easiest part to set. The test also pulled three banana boxes of out-of-date product on a twenty-eight-foot set. Pull anything expired, label it, box it, and give it to the store. Refrigerated Asian strips at twenty-three and Refrigerated Kosher strips at six five eight get recorded under Asian.

checkpoint.q: An Asian Foods item shows as not on set in the lookup. What do you do first?
options: Pull it and set it aside
Verify it: the lookup drops the last UPC digit
checkpoint.explain: The item lookup drops the last UPC digit, so valid items can look not on set. The test store found about six. Verify first.

checkpoint.q: What happens to out-of-date product found in the Asian set?
options: Throw it in the store's trash
Pull it, label it, box it, and give it to the store
Move it to the back of the set
checkpoint.explain: Pull anything expired, label it, box it properly, and give it to the store. The test pulled three banana boxes.

checkpoint.q: Which part of the Asian set has the heavy glass bottles and side-to-side movement?
options: The first two or three bays (sauces and liquids)
checkpoint.explain: The first two or three bays hold heavy glass bottles with private label expansion, and most of that product shifts side to side.

stops.title: Bread
stops.narration: Frozen Bread Dough is two hours and runs cold. Kroger private label and Texas Toast swap places, with Kroger taking the lead. All the rolls come up off the bottom, Pillsbury Grands move down, and the frozen noodles move vertically until they are fully blocked in the last door. Baked Bread is six hours. New Wonder Breakfast items come in, plus one Nature's Own Private Collection Artisan item, and the Wonder mainstream and bun items move to eye level. Natural Foods Bread strips get recorded under Baked Bread. Natural Foods Frozen Bread is one hour of new items, cold, and its frozen inline strips get recorded under it.

checkpoint.q: In Frozen Bread Dough, which two items swap places?
options: Kroger private label and Texas Toast
checkpoint.explain: Kroger private label and Texas Toast swap places, with Kroger taking the lead.

checkpoint.q: In Baked Bread, Wonder mainstream and bun items move to eye level.
checkpoint.explain: Wonder mainstream and bun items move to eye level in their sections.

stops.title: Grocery NIIs
stops.narration: Energy Drinks is one hour, and Red Bull takes the hit: all the sixteen-ounce cans go, along with every eight-point-four-ounce single except Original and Sugar Free. With that space open, Flirt, Starbucks, Gorgie, Liquid Death, and Lotus may move up to the top two shelves, and Bloom and Alani pick up room. Bagels and Cream Cheese is one hour and runs cold. Philadelphia Cranberry Orange spread comes in, and corrected S-R-P sizes on the Kroger cream cheese bars and two-pack move some product and facings. Pasta Sauce and Paper Housewares are one hour each of new items. Store four five nine gets Natural Foods Dry Noodle strips, and those get recorded under Pasta Sauce.

checkpoint.q: Which Red Bull 8.4 oz singles stay in Energy Drinks?
checkpoint.explain: Every 8.4 oz single except Original and Sugar Free comes out, along with all 16 oz cans.

stops.title: Health and Beauty
stops.narration: Health Beauty Care. Upper Respiratory is two hours. Allegra moves off the bottom shelf and trades places with Benadryl, and the tags follow the product. Theraflu and Alka-Seltzer may shift to make room for the new items. Sinus and Allergy strips, plus Miscellaneous Health Beauty Care strips at twenty-three, thirty-one, and three nine one, all get recorded under Upper Respiratory. Digestive Health and First Aid are one hour each of new items, and Analgesics strips get recorded under First Aid.

checkpoint.q: In Upper Respiratory, where does Allegra go?
options: It stays on the bottom shelf
Off the bottom shelf, trading places with Benadryl
checkpoint.explain: Allegra moves off the bottom shelf and trades places with Benadryl. Tags follow the product.

stops.title: Produce
stops.narration: The produce sets go first this week, unless I have set another priority, and both run cold. Salad Mix is two hours. The brand identifier cards on the pusher trays move with their product, and any new or replacement cards from the Vestcom box or the store go in, trimmed to fit. The Taylor Farms Minion Kit and Salad Mix are deleted. Premium Juice is one hour with one new item, and the Suja racks stay in the set.

checkpoint.q: During the Salad Mix reset, what happens to the brand identifier cards on the pusher trays?
options: They stay in the old slot
They go to the store manager
checkpoint.explain: The cards move with their product. New or replacement cards from the Vestcom box or the store go in, trimmed to fit.

checkpoint.q: The Suja racks in Premium Juice come out during the reset.
checkpoint.explain: Do not remove the Suja racks.

checkpoint.q: When do the produce sets get done?
options: First thing, unless I've set another priority
checkpoint.explain: Produce sets get done first thing unless another priority has been set.

stops.title: Meat
stops.narration: Meat is three cold sets at one hour each: Convenient Meals, Hot Dogs, and Bacon, all new items. Smoked Sausage strips show up at nineteen, twenty-three, thirty-one, three nine one, and four five nine, and those get recorded under Hot Dogs.

stops.title: Natural Foods
stops.narration: Natural Foods. The Innovation Endcap is one hour at twenty-eight, fifty-three, three nine one, six five eight, and six eight two, and it is a full swap of the assortment. Stores like to move this endcap. If it is not where the map says, let me know first, and I will get the mapping corrected. Natural Foods Soda and Natural Foods Packaged Snacks are one hour each of new items, and Specialty Soda strips get recorded under Natural Foods Soda.

checkpoint.q: The Innovation Endcap isn't at its mapped location. What do you do?
checkpoint.explain: Let me know first, and I'll get the mapping corrected.

stops.title: Callouts
stops.narration: A few callouts. Billing first: shifts and payroll are complete by end of day Saturday, the seventh. Finish the outstanding Period eight and Period nine sets before the blackout starts. At twenty-three and thirty-one, the Vestcom box is still in transit, so keep an eye on the tracking. If your store has a Relay Manager on site, route project and byway issues through them first. And review your shift photos before signoff, tags installed right and planograms complete.

checkpoint.q: When do shifts and payroll need to be complete for billing?
checkpoint.explain: Shifts and payroll are complete by end of day Saturday, 11/7.

checkpoint.q: Select the stores whose Vestcom box is still in transit.
checkpoint.explain: Stores 23 and 31: the box is still in transit. Keep an eye on the tracking.

stops.title: Looking Ahead
stops.narration: Looking ahead. Period eleven, weeks two and three, are blackout weeks with zero Compass hours. Week four comes back at about thirteen hours, led by Fem Hygiene, and its mapping is in A Useful Folder under twenty twenty-six Mapping and Fixture Files. Period twelve, week one, is about twenty hours.

options: Blackout weeks with zero Kompass hours
checkpoint.explain: Both are blackout weeks. P11W4 comes back at about 13 hours with Fem Hygiene.

stops.title: Key Facts
stops.narration: That is the week. On Asian, verify the U-P-C before you call anything not on set, and box up the expired product for the store. The produce sets go first, and the salad cards travel with the product. Shifts and payroll are done by Saturday. Twenty-three and thirty-one, watch your tracking. Then two weeks of blackout, which you will notice is not the same thing as two weeks of nothing. That is the briefing. The quiz is next.
